a: Common collocation: make a decision (not do a decision).
Heavy rain is preferred over strong rain.
Pay attention is the standard collocation.
Could you please... is a polite formal request.
I see your point, however... softens disagreement.
Just to clarify... helps avoid misunderstanding.
To summarize, we decided X, Y owns Z by date.
Done / Doing / Blocked is a simple status format.
What I'm hearing is... checks understanding.
